title: Hire first employee
summary: Complete the full hiring process including offer letter, onboarding, payroll setup, and benefits enrollment.

parts.title: Draft offer letter
parts.guidance: Draft the offer from the agreed role, reporting line, work location, start date and compensation package. Separate firm commitments from proposed equity, variable pay or conditions that still need a decision. Use the employment template reviewed for that location, and highlight departures from it for the hiring manager and people lead. The resulting draft should make the candidate’s terms clear and expose the few points that must be settled before sending.

parts.title: Send offer for signature
parts.guidance: Check that the offer contains the agreed terms and attachments, then verify the candidate’s delivery address and the company signer. Once the hiring manager clears the package for release, set the signature fields and signer order and send it through the company’s signing service. Route questions and negotiated changes back to the hiring owner, then circulate any revised package consistently to both signers.

parts.title: Candidate accepts (1-3 days)
parts.guidance: Follow up on the offer actually sent, using any agreed response date or extension. Route negotiation questions to the hiring owner and update the package if terms change. On acceptance, check that the required parties signed the same version and reconfirm the start date. Give onboarding the executed agreement and settled employment details so payroll, equipment and introductions can be arranged.

parts.title: Add the employee in your payroll platform
parts.guidance: Choose the employment arrangement from the person’s work country, the employing entity and the reviewed worker classification. For a direct hire, build the payroll profile from the signed agreement: pay basis, amount, start date, location and manager. Let the employee supply sensitive personal and payment details through onboarding. Payroll should resolve missing registrations or funding setup before activation; an EOR hire or contractor needs its own downstream process.

options.title: Default — Add the employee in your payroll platform
options.summary: Use direct employee onboarding when the classification and employing entity support it in the person’s work location. Enter the signed pay terms, start date and verified employee details into payroll. Resolve required registrations and employee onboarding tasks with the payroll team before activation, then check the first-pay setup. Keep any missing information assigned to the person who can supply it.

options.title: EOR hire (outside the US)
options.summary: Assess an EOR for the actual country and role with the people lead and local adviser. Compare the legal employer, contract terms, total cost, benefits, funding and termination responsibilities in the provider’s proposal before committing. Coordinate contract execution and start clearance through the selected arrangement. Use the applicable local payroll and employment process in place of downstream US-specific tasks.
options.when: The hire is outside the US - an employer of record employs them on your behalf

options.title: Contractor-first trial
options.summary: Review the proposed working relationship before considering a contractor engagement. Define the services, deliverables, independence and payment terms, and have the relevant adviser assess classification. If contracting fits, use the contractor agreement and tax-documentation process. If the role is employment in substance, use an employment route. Calling the arrangement a trial does not establish contractor status.
options.when: The engagement starts as a paid contractor trial before a full-time offer

parts.title: Set up payroll schedule
parts.guidance: Set the pay periods, paydays and input cutoffs around the agreed compensation terms. Check the permitted frequency for the employee’s work location and the provider’s actual funding lead time. Work through the first partial period and any bonus, commission or reimbursement treatment with payroll. Share the resulting calendar with the employee and the managers responsible for submitting changes.

parts.title: Employee completes I-9 and W-4
parts.guidance: For employees hired to work in the United States, the employee completes and signs I-9 Section 1 by the first day of employment. The employer or authorized representative completes Section 2 within three business days after that first day, or on the first day if employment lasts fewer than three business days. Let the employee choose acceptable documents. Separately, request Form W-4 when work starts and use it for federal withholding on the first wage payment. Payroll applies IRS default withholding if a valid W-4 is missing and checks applicable state forms. Keep identity and tax records restricted.

verify.how: A completed I-9 with verified documents is on file within 3 business days of the start date (retain it — it is inspectable), plus the signed W-4 in payroll.

parts.title: Set up benefits enrollment
parts.guidance: Identify the enrollment tasks that apply under the selected plans and employment terms. Check eligibility, coverage start, employee contributions and any dependent information needed. Send the employee the relevant plan materials and enrollment route so they can make their own elections. Resolve incomplete or rejected enrollment with the benefits administrator, then reconcile accepted coverage and payroll deductions before confirming that benefits are active.

parts.title: Create company email
parts.guidance: Use the company’s existing email suite and account-naming convention. Check the employee’s identity, company domain, license and access start date, including any existing account or alias that could conflict. The workspace administrator provisions the account under the normal access process. Send activation instructions securely and check that the employee can sign in and receive mail before handing off the mailbox as ready.

options.title: Default — Google Admin console
options.summary: In Google Workspace, the authorized user administrator checks the domain, employee name, existing identities and available license before adding the account. Apply the intended organizational settings and security policy, then send activation instructions securely. Check sign-in and mailbox availability. If a service is still provisioning, investigate its status on the existing account.

references.title: Google Workspace: Add an account for a new user

options.title: Microsoft 365 mailbox
options.summary: In Microsoft 365, the authorized administrator creates or reconciles the employee’s account under the company domain. Assign the appropriate location, license and application access, handling administrative privileges as a separate access decision. Send activation instructions securely and check mailbox and service availability. Resolve licensing or provisioning failures before directing the employee to use the account for work.
options.when: The company runs on Outlook/Teams rather than Google Workspace

references.title: Microsoft Learn: Add users and assign licenses in Microsoft 365

parts.title: Add to the team chat
parts.guidance: Invite the employee using their verified company identity and the access level agreed for their role. Add the team and onboarding channels their manager identifies, checking restricted or externally shared spaces with their owners. Point the employee to communication norms and the support contact. Resolve access problems within the permissions needed for the employee’s work.

parts.title: Grant stock options
parts.guidance: Prepare the proposed award from the offer, current equity plan and grant workflow. Reconcile the recipient, award type, quantity, vesting and pricing support with counsel or the equity administrator. Obtain the required board or delegated approval before issuing documents or changing ownership records. Track execution and acceptance against the approved terms, with the grant linked to its authorization and resulting ledger entry.

metadata.supportReason: Gusto's Embedded Payroll API supports onboarding, pay schedules, and payroll; Carta's API drafts option grants for board approval. Offer letter drafting automatable. Background checks and benefits selection require human interaction.

geoNotes.summary: First-hire setup means an appointment letter, checking EPF/ESI applicability thresholds, a state shops-and-establishments registration, and monthly TDS on salary against the company's TAN — the EPFO employer portal anchors the social-security side.

gov.uk publishes the exact first-hire checklist: right-to-work checks, employers' liability insurance, PAYE registration before the first payday, a written statement of particulars on day one, and pension auto-enrolment.

Before the first payslip: a Betriebsnummer from the Federal Employment Agency, registration with the employee's health insurer (which routes all social insurance), statutory accident insurance with the sector's Berufsgenossenschaft, and wage tax via ELSTER.

Every hire starts with the DPAE to URSSAF before the start date; add a written contract (French language), affiliation to the mandatory mutuelle and retirement schemes, and the initial médecine du travail visit.

The first-hire checklist is national: report the admission to Segurança Social before the start date, take out the mandatory work-accident insurance (private insurers), and put the written contract terms in place — the government guide walks it through.

Before the first payday: a payroll (RP) account on the business number, provincial workers'-compensation registration, and employment-standards minimums from the employee's province (federally regulated industries follow the Canada Labour Code).
